contract.canonicalPurpose: Reader turns a saved article or PDF into a focused place to read, annotate, revisit, and discuss it.
contract.audience: People who save serious reading and need to retain useful notes beside the source.
contract.job: Import a guest PDF, read pages, save page-linked notes and revisit them after reload.
contract.thesis: Keep the document central and place compact page notes beside it, stacking below at narrow widths.
contract.system: Existing charcoal reading shell, gray text hierarchy, project Button colors, 16/24px gutters, single-column mobile and document-plus-22rem-notes desktop.
contract.signature: Each note returns to its numbered PDF page.
contract.risk: Native PDF iframe is replaced by the existing local PDF.js renderer; a real synthetic document validates rendering and the worker stays bundled locally.
